card.name: Injection preparation and dilution instructions
card.fires_on: Words inside reconstitution and dilution directions for injectable drugs, often partway through words like particulate, reconstitute and diluents. It also fires on nearby small words and numbers in those steps.

modes.label: Split words in prep steps
modes.description: Fires on the middle piece of a long word such as particulate, reconstitute or diluents.

modes.label: Linking words in prep text
modes.description: Fires on small words or numbers in sentences about preparing or inspecting the infusion solution.
